These sections contain existing material and plans for further development.
Their inclusion here does not change the review status of any research record.

- [Reviews](/reviews/index.qmd): plans for an organized review programme.
  No review committee has been formed. Individual reviews can already be
  recorded on research pages; the [status badge explanation](/reviews/status-badge/index.qmd)
  describes the existing verification fields.
- [Surveys](/surveys/index.qmd): expository material, including UC for Gamers
  and the UC Encyclopedia. The section's format and development priorities
  remain open for discussion.
- [Resources](/resources/index.qmd): reusable templates and research prompts.
